title: 二十二集网第二十一章第一刀
lines: 第二十二章网
阿芸的案子结了。周乡绅被押进大牢，秋后问斩。沈默站在衙门口，看着囚车远去，脸上没有表情。他转身回了义庄，把阿芸的尸体重新入殓，买了一副薄棺，雇人抬到城外葬了。坟很小，没有碑，只有一堆新土。他在坟前站了一会儿，什么也没说。
宋焘站在远处，看着沈默的背影。他没有跟上去。他知道沈默不需要安慰，他只需要下一个案子。刘大的案子，已经在等着了。他转身走了。
刘大死在城西的巷子里，身上有伤，有的是被打的，有的是被掐的。衙门说凶手是一个乞丐，已经抓了，判了死刑。沈默去看那个乞丐，乞丐不认罪，说他没有杀人。沈默信他。因为他手上的伤，和刘大身上的伤，对不上。
沈默查了半个月，查出了一个惊人的事实。刘大不是一个人杀的，是一群人。那些人，是本地一个帮派的人。帮派的老大，姓赵，人称赵五爷。赵五爷在城西开了一家赌场，谁不听话，就打谁。刘大欠了赌场的钱，还不起，被他们打死了。乞丐只是路过，被拉来顶罪的。
沈默找到了一个证人，那天夜里看见赵五爷的人从巷子里出来。但证人不敢作证。赵五爷和府衙的捕头是拜把子兄弟。
沈默去找宋焘。宋焘坐在义庄门口，手里端着一碗茶，像是在等他。
“查到了？”宋焘问。
“查到了。”沈默说，“刘大是被赵五爷的人打死的。乞丐是被冤枉的。但证人不敢作证。”
宋焘沉默了一会儿。“证人交给我。你去告。”
沈默看着他。“你不会杀人吧？”
宋焘愣了一下，然后笑了。“不会。我只是……让他说实话。”
沈默没有再问。他写了状子，递到府衙。

府衙里，师爷正要像往常一样把状子压下来，赵五爷的拜把子兄弟、捕头孙德已经站在堂下，等着把沈默轰出去。但这一次，证人来了。那证人是赵五爷赌场里的一个伙计，平日里胆小如鼠，给赵五爷磕头都怕磕不响。可那天他上了堂，整个人像换了个人。眼睛直勾勾的，不看任何人，只盯着地面，声音平得像在念经。他说出那天夜里的每一个细节——赵五爷的人在巷子里打刘大，打了多久，谁先动的手，刘大喊了几声，最后不动了。他连赵五爷衣领上沾的血在左边还是右边都说出来了。
赵五爷在堂下听得面如死灰。他想喊冤，嘴张开，声音却像被掐住了。他盯着那个伙计的眼睛——空的，像两口枯井。他忽然觉得，站在堂上的不是人，是一具被什么力量提着线的木偶。他不敢喊了。
赵五爷被抓了起来，乞丐被放了。
沈默站在衙门口，看着赵五爷被押出来。他的脸上没有笑，只是站在那里，看着。宋焘站在远处，看着他。
天黑了，沈默回到义庄。宋焘不在。门口放着一碗茶，还是热的。沈默端起茶碗，喝了一口。茶很苦，但他觉得暖。
他坐在门口，等着。等宋焘回来。等下一个案子。
宋焘没有去找沈默。他一个人坐在城隍庙里，看着天书。天书翻开到阿芸那一页，字迹已经淡了。上面写着：阿芸，功德。周乡绅害之。沈默查实，周乡绅伏法。
他伸出手，摸了摸那行字。纸是凉的，滑的，和普通的纸一样。他闭上眼睛，脑子里全是阿芸的脸。她站在桥下，浑身湿透，脸是白的，眼睛是黑的。她看着他，不说话。
他睁开眼睛，站起来，走到庙门口。月亮很大，照得地上白花花的。他站在那里，看着月亮，看了很久。
他不知道，在星河的那一边，有一个人也在看着月亮。
云海站在星河岸边，低头看着人间。她看见宋焘的背影，看见沈默的义庄，看见阿芸的坟。她也看见天庭深处，那些星宫里的灯火。司命星君的宫门关得紧紧的，禄存星君的算盘珠子拨得飞快。还有其他人，那些藏得更深的人，那些她叫得出名字和叫不出名字的人。他们都在看着人间。看着宋焘，看着沈默。
云海没有动。她不能动。她一动，那些人就知道宋焘背后有人。宋焘必须是一个人。一个什么都没有的人，才能无所畏惧地走下去。如果他背后有她，他就有了退路，有了顾虑，有了可以被拿捏的软肋。所以她只能看着。
她想起天帝召见她的那天。天界大殿，云海深处，天帝坐在九重之上，声音不重，但每一个字都像石头落在深潭里。
“天界有人在下棋。棋盘是人间的善人，棋子是他们的命。他们收割功德，篡改因果，把天道变成自己的私器。朕知道，但朕不能动。朕一动，整个天界都会乱。”
云海站在那里，没有说话。
“朕需要一个局外人。”天帝说，“一个不在天界棋局里的人。你替朕去人间找。找到了，就看着他，护着他。让他从人间开始，一件一件地翻。翻到那些人藏不住的时候，朕才能动手。”
云海问：“这个人是谁？”
天帝说：“你去找。找到了，你就知道了。”
云海转身，走出天界，站在星河岸边，看着人间。她看了很久。她看见很多人走过，没有一个是她要找的人。
直到她看见宋焘跪在天书前，伸手想改商三官的命。她拦住了他。她说：“天书不能改。但你可以做。”那时候她只是不想让他犯错。但那一瞬间，她知道，他就是她要找的人。一个想改天书的人，一个不甘心只看不动的人。天帝要的，就是这样的人。
她看着他弃了天书，入人间，找一把刀。她看着他找到沈默，看着沈默翻了阿芸的案。她看着他站在月光下，不知道自己做的事情，正一件一件地掀开天界的盖子。
她没有告诉他。她只是看着。
content_en:
Chapter 22.net
Ayun's case is closed. Squire Zhou was imprisoned and asked to be executed by Queen Qiu. Silently stood at the yamen gate, watching the prison car go away, with no expression on his face. He turned back to Yizhuang, put Ayun's body back into the coffin, bought a thin coffin, and hired someone to carry it outside the city for burial. The tomb is very small, with no monument and just a pile of fresh soil. He stood in front of the grave for a while and said nothing.
Song Tao stood in the distance, looking at the silent figure. He didn't follow. He knew that silence didn't need comfort, he just needed the next case. Liu Da's case is already waiting. He turned and left.
Liu Da died in an alley in the west of the city. He had injuries on his body, some from being beaten and some from being strangled. The Yamen said that the murderer was a beggar and had been caught and sentenced to death. Silently went to see the beggar. The beggar did not admit guilt and said that he did not kill anyone. Believe him silently. Because the injury on his hand didn't match the injury on Liu Da's body.
After searching for half a month, Shen Shen found out a surprising fact. Liu Da was not killed by one person, but by a group of people. Those people were members of a local gang. The leader of the gang, whose surname is Zhao, is known as Mr. Zhao Wu. Mr. Zhao Wu opened a casino in the west of the city and beat anyone who disobeyed. Liu Da owed money to the casino and couldn't pay it back, so they beat him to death. The beggar was just passing by and was dragged to bear the blame.
Shen Mo found a witness who saw Zhao Wuye's people coming out of the alley that night. But the witnesses were afraid to testify. Mr. Zhao Wu and the government's catcher are brothers who are worshippers.
Silently went to find Song Tao. Song Tao was sitting at the door of Yizhuang, holding a bowl of tea in his hand, as if waiting for him.
"Have you found it?" Song Tao asked.
"It was found out." Shen Mo said, "Liu Da was beaten to death by Zhao Wuye's men. The beggar was wrongly accused. But the witnesses did not dare to testify."
Song Tao was silent for a while. "Leave the witness to me. You go and sue."
Look at him silently. "You don't know how to kill, right?"
Song Tao was stunned for a moment, then smiled. "No. I just...let him tell the truth."
Silence didn't ask again. He wrote a petition and handed it to the government office.
In the government office, the master was about to suppress the lawsuit as usual, but Zhao Wuye's brother Sun De, the head catcher, was already standing in the hall, waiting to blast the silence out. But this time, the witnesses came. The witness was a guy from Mr. Zhao Wu's casino. He was usually as timid as a mouse, and even kowtowed to Mr. Zhao for fear that his kowtow would not make a sound. But that day when he went to court, he looked completely different. His eyes were straight, not looking at anyone, only staring at the ground, and his voice was as calm as chanting sutras. He told every detail of that night - Zhao Wuye's men beat Liu Da in the alley, how long they beat him, who made the first move, Liu yelled several times, and finally stopped moving. He even told whether the blood on Mr. Zhao Wu's collar was on the left or the right.
Mr. Zhao Wu's face turned pale after hearing this. He wanted to cry out, but when he opened his mouth, his voice seemed to be strangled. He stared into the boy's eyes - empty, like two dry wells. He suddenly felt that the person standing in the hall was not a human being, but a puppet held by strings by some force. He didn't dare to shout anymore.
Mr. Zhao Wu was arrested and the beggar was released.
Standing silently at the yamen gate, watching Mr. Zhao Wu being escorted out. There was no smile on his face, he just stood there, watching. Song Tao stood in the distance, looking at him.
It was getting dark, so I returned to Yizhuang silently. Song Tao is not here. There is a bowl of tea at the door, still hot. Shen Mo picked up the tea bowl and took a sip. The tea was bitter, but he felt warm.
He sat at the door and waited. Wait for Song Tao to come back. Waiting for the next case.
Song Tao didn't go looking for Shen Mo. He sat alone in the City God's Temple, reading the Book of Heaven. The book of heaven opened to Ayun's page, and the handwriting had faded. It says: Ayun, merit. The Zhou squire harmed him. Silently verifying the truth, Zhou Squire went to the law.
He stretched out his hand and touched the line of words. The paper is cool and slippery, just like regular paper. He closed his eyes, and all he could think about was Ayun's face. She stood under the bridge, soaked to the skin, with a white face and black eyes. She looked at him without speaking.
He opened his eyes, stood up, and walked to the temple door. The moon was very big, illuminating the ground with white flowers. He stood there and looked at the moon for a long time.
He didn't know that on the other side of the galaxy, there was a person looking at the moon.
The sea of ​​clouds stood on the bank of the Galaxy, looking down at the world. She saw Song Tao's back, the silent Yizhuang, and Ayun's grave. She also saw the lights in the star palace deep in the heaven. Lord Si Mingxing's palace door was tightly closed, and Lord Lucun Xing's abacus was moving rapidly. There were others, those who lay deeper, those she could name and those she could not. They are all looking at the world. Looking at Song Tao, looking at Silence.
The sea of ​​clouds did not move. She couldn't move. As soon as she moved, those people knew there was someone behind Song Tao. Song Tao must be alone. Only a person who has nothing can go on without fear. If he had her behind his back, he would have an escape route, worries, and a weakness that could be manipulated. So she could only watch.
She remembered the day the Emperor summoned her. In the Heavenly Palace, deep in the sea of ​​clouds, the Emperor of Heaven sits on the ninth level. His voice is not loud, but every word is like a stone falling into a deep pool.
"There are people playing chess in the heaven. The chessboard is for the good people in the world, and the chess pieces are their lives. They harvest merit, tamper with cause and effect, and turn the way of heaven into their own private weapons. I know, but I can't move. If I move, the entire heaven will be in chaos."
Yunhai stood there without speaking.
"I need an outsider." The Emperor of Heaven said, "A person who is not in the chess game of heaven. You go to the human world to find him for me. When you find him, look at him and protect him. Let him start from the human world and go through it one by one. Only when those people can't hide it can I take action."
Yunhai asked: "Who is this person?"
The Emperor of Heaven said: "Look for it. If you find it, you will know it."
Yunhai turned around, walked out of the heaven, stood on the bank of the star river, and looked at the world. She looked at it for a long time. She saw many people walking by, but none of them was the person she was looking for.
Until she saw Song Tao kneeling in front of the Book of Heaven, reaching out to change Shang Sanguan's life. She stopped him. She said: "The Book of Heaven cannot be changed. But you can do it." At that time, she just didn't want him to make mistakes. But at that moment, she knew that he was the person she was looking for. A person who wants to change the Book of Heaven, and a person who is unwilling to just look at it. What the Emperor of Heaven wants is this kind of person.
She watched him abandon the Book of Heaven and enter the human world in search of a knife. She watched him find Shen Mo and watched Shen Shen turn over Ayun's case. She looked at him standing in the moonlight, not knowing what he was doing, lifting the lid of heaven one by one.
She didn't tell him. She just watched.
